Speaker: Hrefna
Text: Six weeks I waited. Heart, skull, flesh, bones, nightshade. I did it all right. I know I did.
Notes: OFFEN: Fuer Q01 gibt es im Konzept nur Schluesseldialoge, kein vollstaendiges Skript wie bei Q00. Speaker: Hrefna
Text: You came. Now you come. Where were you when he took the farm and my husband took to the bottle?
Notes: Betonung auf "Now" (im Konzept mit Sternchen hervorgehoben, fuer CK-Text entfernt)

Speaker: Player
Text: The family was burning. No one was left to answer.

Speaker: Hrefna
Text: So I answered myself. Held him under till the bubbles stopped. It was quieter than I thought.

Speaker: Player
Text: What did you expect the silence to tell you?

Speaker: Hrefna
Text: That I had done the right thing. It told me only that he was gone.
Notes: Erweiterung 26.09.2026; Hrefnas Zweifel bleibt menschlich, keine Erklärung durch Veyra.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Grief kills once. The second choice tells us what she is willing to carry.
